section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks

propositions.proposition: 由于慈善机构和非政府组织可能被用于洗钱或违反制裁，因此需要对其进行审查以确保其持续合法性。
source_quotes: these organizations could be used to launder illicit funds or breach sanctions requirements.
charities and NGOs need to be scrutinized to ensure their ongoing legitimacy.

trigger_or_context: 这些组织可能被用于洗钱或违反制裁

propositions.proposition: 研究慈善机构和非政府组织时，应查询相关注册机构以确认其免税状态和年度纳税申报，并咨询提供公正评价的网站。
source_quotes: While researching charities and NGOs, be sure to search the relevant registration authorities to confirm their exempt status and their annual tax return filings. Also, consult websites that provide unbiased evaluations of charities and NGOs. It is likely that larger organizations will have a list of approved websites to conduct this research.
